name: Marcellus Consistent Compounders
simpleDescription: Buys 25–30 high-quality Indian companies and holds them for years. The idea: pick businesses that grow steadily and quietly, not the loudest stocks.
proDescription: Concentrated multi-cap PMS focused on capital-efficient compounders with high ROCE, low debt, and predictable cash flows. Benchmark Nifty 500 TRI.

name: Edelweiss Crossover Opportunities Fund
simpleDescription: A fund that backs late-stage private companies just before they list on the stock market. Higher risk, higher potential reward, locked in for years.
proDescription: Category II AIF investing in pre-IPO and late-stage growth equity across Indian unicorns and soonicorns. Closed-ended 7-year structure with extension.

name: True Beacon One
simpleDescription: Tries to make money in both rising and falling markets by going long on some stocks and short on others. Built for investors who want lower swings.
proDescription: Category III long-short AIF with market-neutral and directional sleeves. Targets 12–15% net of fees with sub-10% drawdown.
